answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity gets a kernel of behavioural features (timing, tool mix, response length) recorded per epoch; the jade score measures drift from its own history, and a walnut-shaped tolerance band flags identities whose profile shifts abruptly across epochs. Agents must stay consistent or re-earn reputation from zero. Sybils pay: each fake identity needs sustained, correlated effort across many epochs, multiplying operational cost linearly per identity.
